crossRefs.note: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

parallels.note: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye, than for a rich man to enter into God’s…
It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

translations.web: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”
translations.bsb: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter the kingdom of God.”
translations.kjv: For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
translations.asv: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God.
